name: Compound (Comptroller COMP distribution)
summary: Proposal 62 changed the supplier and borrower COMP-index initialization checks from greater-than-or-equal to strict greater-than. Accounts whose market index equalled compInitialIndex remained uninitialized, so a later claim calculated rewards from index zero and transferred vastly excess COMP.
notes: Proposal 62 emitted the last pre-incident NewImplementation(address,address) event and selected the defect-bearing Comptroller implementation.

Contemporaneous analysis reports approximately $80 million in excess COMP distributed through the Proposal 62 bug. The structured 91,170.351328585460017120 COMP component is the exact transfer in the code-age anchor transaction and provides a $27.30 million onchain cross-check.
